Name: Fippsie's Japanese Onsen Redux
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
I spoke to Fippsie and got blessings to upload. Combined and updated.

The pool restores stamina and the buildings are fully animated.

[b][size=4]Building Costs[/size][/b]
[spoiler][b][size=4]Small Onsen[/size][/b]
[b]Cost:[/b] 15,000g
[b]Materials:[/b] 250 Stone, 100 Hardwood, 35 Clay, 10 Refined Quartz
[b]Build Time:[/b] 2 days

[b][size=4]Large Onsen[/size][/b]
[b]Cost:[/b] 45,000g
[b]Materials:[/b] 750 Stone, 300 Hardwood, 100 Clay, 30 Refined Quartz
[b]Build Time:[/b] 3 days[/spoiler]

The Small Onsen is more compact while the Large Onsen offers more buildable interior space.
